sections.title: Naming a kind of film
sections.content: Hungarian often builds a genre word by gluing a noun onto film: akció + film = akciófilm ("action film"), rajz + film = rajzfilm ("cartoon", literally "drawing film"). Other genres are simply their own separate noun, like vígjáték ("comedy") and dráma ("drama").

Compounds like akciófilm and rajzfilm are just two nouns glued together with no linking vowel and no case ending in between — the same simple pattern you've already met in words like munkahely ("workplace").
